notes: Systemic: the jp-srrv-* records (24 in shard) are AI-generated from a handful of category templates; body text, Key Compliance Intent, systems/commodities tags and sometimes UN equivalents come from the template for the category rather than the title (fuel/EV template on accelerator control, audible warning, engine/power train; lighting template on controls/tell-tales, speedometer, windshield wipers; certification template on ALKS). Bodies contain no regulation text. Citation 'SRRV / TRIAS' is duplicated across 10 records. The three jp-jvsregs-* records contain real article text from e-Gov and are largely sound; Art. 5 body is genuinely a single paragraph (precheck body-thin dismissed). Not independently verified: source URLs for env.go.jp, japaneselawtranslation and telec pages, and exact SRRV article numbers named in Related Regulations lines.
